label: Observe
text: This is an illustrative example. The success rate changes from ninety-seven point four to ninety-nine point seven percent.

label: Subtract
text: Subtract the starting rate from the final rate. The difference is two point three percentage points.

label: Compare
text: Divide that difference by the starting rate, then multiply by one hundred. The relative increase is about two point three six percent.

label: Qualify
text: These numbers describe what changed. They do not establish why it changed. Keep observations separate from explanations.
